scope: Only producer preflight, per-shard checkpoint and downloaded-evidence validation blocks in the local runner

observed_failures: Prior preflight accepted a mismatched mocked repository producer run
Prior runner did not preserve qualification and producer manifest copies
Prior download handling accepted a reuse receipt with status failed
red.earlier_harness_setup_failure: Missing marked source blocks; retained as setup history, not the behavioral RED claim

contract.ids: Canonical positive decimal strings up to18digits, or exact safe integer JSON numbers; both repository BUILD variables must match
contract.digest: sha256: followed by64 lowercase hex digits
contract.before_resources: Bounded regular nonsymlink qualification/manifest inputs, passed matching source, matching producer run/attempt and qualification, matching repository build pins
contract.per_shard: Preserve exact qualification and frozen manifest copies with SHA256 equality checks
contract.after_download: Reuse, proof and archive status/schema/source/run/artifact/digest/size consistency; manifest equality against frozen producer before publication-cache verification or removal
